verdict.rationale: gstack ships a dedicated /gstack-upgrade skill. It detects whether the install is global or vendored, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new, so users get fixes without reinstalling. It also supports opt-in auto-upgrade via a GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE setting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that upgrades work smoothly, and detail on how auto-upgrade triggers and handles rollback or version pinning.
